data.title: Hong Kong bookstores closing after ‘sedition’ raids
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong bookshop raided by national security police earlier this month announced on Wednesday that it would close after 50 years in business, while another has shut down ahead of schedule.

data.title: Missing Russian siblings’ motorcycle found buried
data.description: PATTAYA - The disassembled motorcycle belonging to two Russian siblings missing since Sunday was found buried in a forest in tambon Huay Yai on Wednesday morning. Four people with digging tools are suspected to have fled the scene.

data.title: A fight for survival
data.description: The Devil’s Mouth , an upcoming survival horror thriller, will premiere on July 29 on Prime Video.

data.title: Education ministry going paperless
data.description: The government has backed the Education Ministry's plan to introduce a fully paperless e-Office system across all agencies from Jan 1, 2027, as part of its drive to modernise Thailand's public administration through digital technology.

data.title: SSO appeals order halting board vote preparations
data.description: The Social Security Office (SSO) will appeal a Supreme Administrative Court injunction that has temporarily suspended preparations for the Sept 27 Social Security Board election, Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat said on Tuesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek backs himself to beat Dayakaev ‘easily’ as flyweight talk grows
data.description: Superlek believes he can avenge his controversial defeat by Abdulla Dayakaev “easily” at The Inner Circle 25 – as pressure grows on the Thai star to end his three-fight losing run and finally address the future of his long-dormant flyweight kickboxing title.

data.title: US Senate confirms Clayton as Trump intelligence chief
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Senate has confirmed Jay Clayton as President Donald Trump's top intelligence official, putting a permanent chief in charge of the country's spy agencies as the president revives unsupported election fraud claims ahead of the midterms.

data.title: 'Sirikasapanasilp' Exhibition Fuses Rare Commemorative Coins with Fine Jewellery Art
data.description: Treasury Department and Siam Paragon honour Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother through a showcase of rare coins and jewel-encrusted art

data.title: US, Saudi forces strike Iran-backed groups in Iraq
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US and Saudi Arabian forces said they struck Iran-backed militants in Iraq on Wednesday in retaliation for recent attacks, following a short pause in Iran war hostilities.

data.title: Phuket and Samui Evolve into Global Property Investment Hubs as Foreign Buyers Shift Market Dynamics
data.description: Israeli investors embrace long-term leaseholds on Samui as villa supply outpaces Phuket, prompting calls for tighter regulation and property tax reform

data.title: TAT Celebrates UNESCO Status for Wat Phra Mahathat with Year-Round Campaign
data.description: Bangkok, 27 July 2026– The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is celebrating the inscription of Wat Phra MahathatWoramahawihanin Nakhon Si Thammarat on the UNESCO World Heritage List as Thailand’s ninth World Heritage property and sixth cultural property. TAT is carrying this historic recognition forward through the“ The Twelve Sacred DiscoveriesNakhon Si Thammarat: A Journey to World Heritage”campaign, a year-round programme inviting visitors to discover the site’s living Buddhist heritage across the seasons.

data.title: A day with a master: Woosie's swing still had its magic
data.description: The definition of the phrase 'Paths Crossed' comes from the literal image of two physical paths or trails intersecting. Metaphorically, it implies that the journeys of two people briefly overlapped. The phrase is often used to suggest an element of fate or destiny in a surprise encounter. My encounter with Ian Woosnam was on a driving range in Poland, where he was hitting a few balls prior to playing in a seniors' event.

data.title: Search for Mercedes-Benz driver who jumped into Phuket sea
data.description: PHUKET: Rescue workers are searching for the woman driver of a Mercedes-Benz car who jumped into the sea from a bridge linking the island province and the mainland on Tuesday night.

data.title: Japan coral protectors race to save reefs from heat 'bomb'
data.description: ONNA (JAPAN) - From "heatwave simulators" to ecological bootcamps, scientists and conservationists are trying ways to revive and reinforce the famous coral reefs off Japan's Okinawa, decimated by climate-driven bleaching two summers ago.

data.title: Zelensky hails 'good' Trump talks on Patriot air defenses
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sought licenses to produce Patriot air-defense interceptors during a "good meeting" with US counterpart Donald Trump on Tuesday, as he underscored Russia's Vladimir Putin's loss of initiative on the war front due to heavy losses.

data.title: The next generation of pink
data.description: Twenty-five years after the iconic romcom Legally Blonde first introduced audiences to the relentlessly optimistic Elle Woods, Prime Video is turning back the clock to explore the making of one of pop culture's most beloved screen heroines.

data.title: Leeteuk and Heechul bring sub-unit Super Junior-83z to Thunder Dome
data.description: Leeteuk and Heechul of Super Junior have teamed up to form a new unit, Super Junior-83z, to celebrate their enduring friendship. Organised by SM True, the duo will hold the "2026 Super Junior-83z Fancon Tour [1983] In Bangkok" on Aug 15 at Thunder Dome.

data.title: Atta Gallery brings together 11 artists for 'Anonymous'
data.description: Art lovers are invited to experience 11 artworks by 11 artists with an innocent eye during "Anonymous", which is running at Atta Gallery until Aug 16.

data.title: LeeHi to play first solo show in BKK
data.description: South Korean singer and songwriter LeeHi will be in town for "LeeHi & 808 Hi Recordings World Tour 2026 In Bangkok" at the Sphere Hall in Emsphere, Sukhumvit Road, on Aug 16 at 7pm.

data.title: Betagro at Grand Halal Bangkok 2026: Serving Halal Food to the World
data.description: Bangkok – 24 July 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, led by Sunisa Maud-En, Managing Director, Quality Assurance and Quality Management Office (1st from left), together with Sorached Charoenthammaporn, Assistant Vice President - Global Trading (4th from left), welcomed Samarn Kopitak, Subcommittee Member of the Halal Product Inspection, The Central Islamic Council of Thailand (CICOT), and Advisor to the Sheikhul Islam of Thailand (2nd from left), and delegation, on the occasion of Betagro’s participation for the second consecutive year in the international halal trade exhibition, Grand Halal Bangkok 2026, held from July 15–17, 2026, at the Bangkok International Trade and Exhibition Centre (BITEC), Bangna.

data.title: Five dead after powerful Japan quake, others missing
data.description: KUMAMOTO (JAPAN) - A major quake that badly damaged a shopping mall and a factory in Japan killed at least five people, emergency services said on Wednesday.
